audit_logs_workspace_write.name: audit_logs_workspace_write
audit_logs_workspace_write.withCheck:
(
        "audit_logs"."workspace_id" = NULLIF(current_setting('app.workspace_id', true), '')::uuid
        or (
          "audit_logs"."workspace_id" is null
          and nullif(current_setting('app.workspace_id', true), '') is null
        )
      )

roles_member_select.name: roles_member_select
roles_member_select.using:
exists (
        select 1
        from memberships m
        where m.workspace_id = "roles"."workspace_id"
          and m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')
      )
